Hi Avery / Jordan —

Thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap and recommended next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Procurement path options you asked about: (1) credit card for pilot (fastest), (2) PO / paper contract + monthly invoicing (typical for enterprise), or (3) AWS Marketplace listing (longer set-up, can be preferred by platform ops).
- Security gating: you mentioned SOC 2 Type II and a short security questionnaire from legal. We can provide our SOC2 summary and a draft DPA to speed review; the questionnaire completion depends on a couple of clarifications below.

Requests / asks from Helio Health:
1) Can you confirm whether procurement prefers a PO or Marketplace for the pilot? If PO, please share the expected approval timeline and whether standard vendor forms are required.
2) Jordan: can you attach the security questionnaire PDF (if there's a different version than the one we reviewed)?
3) Any procurement contact (name/email) we should loop in?

What Redwood will do next:
- Attached: SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf and DPA_draft_Redwood_v1.docx for your legal team to review.
- I'll loop in Aditya (commercial lead) and Monica (contracts) to coordinate paperflow options and estimate turnaround for PO-based onboarding.

Proposed next milestone: once procurement path is confirmed, we'll produce a simple mutual action plan (MAP) with dates for DPA sign, security questionnaire completion, and invoice/PO issuance.

Thanks —

Thanks Grace — quick answers from commercial:
- For PO-based onboarding we typically need: fully executed DPA, signed MSA (or countersigned redline), and a PO referencing the invoice terms. If they provide standard vendor forms, we can review but prefer using our MSA to avoid custom clauses.
- Timeline: if customer's procurement/legal are responsive, typical turnaround is ~10 business days for a straightforward PO + DPA. If they push redlines, add 1–2 weeks depending on legal cycles.
- Marketplace: if Helio can buy via AWS Marketplace (or GCP marketplace later), time-to-first-bill can be 2–4 weeks (integration + listing acceptance), so not ideal for an urgent pilot.
- Pilot discounts: we can offer a 25% pilot credit for the first month to reduce friction; I'll confirm approval with finance but this is within typical SDR/AE leeway.

Monica — can you prepare the MSA + DPA package and a short note for procurement that explains the PO reference fields they should include? I'll draft a one-page MAP for the client after Jordan confirms PO timeline.

-Aditya
